description: This file defines the AttendanceRepository class, which provides high-level methods for managing attendance data, including marking attendance, retrieving daily or weekly attendance, and syncing pending data from local storage to a remote server. It integrates with other components like ApiClient, Endpoints, and LocalDb.

classes.name: AttendanceRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages attendance data operations and synchronization with remote APIs.

methods.name: markNow
methods.description: Marks attendance for the current timestamp, with optional notes, student name, and period. Delegates to the local data source.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Retrieves daily attendance data for the specified date from the local data source.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Retrieves weekly attendance starting from the specified week start date.

methods.name: syncPending
methods.description: Attempts to synchronize pending attendance entries stored locally with the remote API, processing each entry sequentially and clearing the queue upon success.

methods.name: _maybeBaseUrl
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the base URL if configured; returns null otherwise.

methods.name: _formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string.
